name: neo4j-mcp-server
description: MCP Server for Neo4j Requirements Traceability

scripts.deploy:mcp: npm run build && rsync -a --delete dist/ ~/mcp-servers/neo4j-mcp/dist/ && rsync -a package.json package-lock.json ~/mcp-servers/neo4j-mcp/ && cd ~/mcp-servers/neo4j-mcp && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
